description: Public Service Enterprise Group Incorporated, incorporated under the laws of the State of New Jersey in 1985 with principal executive offices at 80 Park Plaza in Newark, New Jersey, is a public utility holding company that, acting through its wholly owned subsidiaries, is a predominantly regulated electric and gas utility and a nuclear generation business, and its business plan focuses on achieving growth by allocating capital primarily toward regulated investments in an effort to continue to improve the sustainability and predictability of its business and realizing the value of the consistent and reliable carbon-free generation from its nuclear units. It principally conducts its business through two direct wholly owned subsidiaries, PSE&G, a New Jersey corporation incorporated in 1924 which is a franchised public utility in New Jersey, a transmission owner in PJM, and a provider of distribution service to 2.4 million electric customers and 1.9 million gas customers in a service area covering approximately 2,600 square miles across New Jersey, and PSEG Power, its nuclear generation business.
